reviews.text: Explained the cyber crime sections in simple Kannada and helped me write to the bank the same day. Clear about fees.
Very knowledgeable about online fraud cases. Office was busy so I waited about 40 minutes.
Experienced and calm. Took time to read all my documents before giving advice.
Good advice but replies to calls were slow. Fees were as quoted.
Very supportive in a domestic violence matter. Did not charge for the first meeting and explained the protection order process.
Patient and respectful. Helped with the application to the Magistrate under the DV Act.
Helped me recover unpaid wages from a contractor. Practical advice.
Filed my consumer complaint online through e-Daakhil. Simple process and low fee.
Knew exactly what to do about a UPI fraud. Asked me to call 1930 first, which helped freeze the money.
Strong on cyber law. Expensive, but the notice he sent got the fake profile removed quickly.
Made me feel safe talking about harassment. Explained every step and stayed in touch.
Good guidance on a dowry harassment complaint. Hindi and Kannada both fine.
Knows property law well but was hard to reach on phone.
Helped me file a POSH complaint at work and prepared me for the committee hearing.
Took up a caste abuse case seriously and guided me on the SC/ST Act.
